name: TC-12-pm-calendar
description: TC-12.1: PM Calendar — Navigate to calendar view, verify layout, and explore scheduling features

doc_metadata.title: TC-12.1 — PM Calendar
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to the PM Calendar page. The calendar provides a visual overview of all scheduled preventive maintenance activities organized by date.

doc_metadata.title: TC-12.1 — Calendar Month View
doc_metadata.caption: The PM Calendar displays scheduled maintenance tasks in a monthly view. Tasks are color-coded by status: Draft (slate), Pending (amber), Approved (blue), Release (violet), Completed (green).

doc_metadata.title: TC-12.3 — Maintenance Activity List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Maintenance Activity. Activities are created from the PM Calendar and represent scheduled preventive maintenance tasks.

doc_metadata.title: TC-12.3 — Maintenance Activities
doc_metadata.caption: The maintenance activity list shows all scheduled activities with their status, due date, assigned resource, and linked work orders.

doc_metadata.title: TC-12.3 — PM Activity List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to PM Activity. PM Activities define reusable preventive maintenance templates with task sequences, checklists, and resource requirements.

doc_metadata.title: TC-12.3 — PM Activity Templates
doc_metadata.caption: PM Activity templates define standard maintenance procedures that are instantiated when scheduled maintenance is triggered.
